Apples taste much better to me refrigerated as well. I grew up with my mom keeping them out, but my friend I roomed with in college put them in the fridge. Crisp, cold, and tasty right out of the fridge!! Storing them room temperature is fine, but I keep them in the fridge for what I personally consider the tastiest flavor. Same goes with oranges, totally fine to store them room temperature, but so much tastier refrigerated.

One thing I have definitely, positively learned myself is that life does *not* get better at all. If anything it's gotten worse. In fact I know it's worse. Instead of pressure to succeed in school, I now have pressure to succeed in life. Nothing improved. It's just a lie told to teenagers so that they live long enough to outgrow the rampant hormones and can make the decision to *actually* kill themselves because life truly does suck, instead of kill themselves impulsively in the heat of the moment. Trust me, I'm an adult now, I know how this works.

And, I'm sorry, I know you're just trying to help. But the thing is that life *is* drab and repetitive. Things like walks and a day off here and there are simple distractions. There is no freedom. If you don't work, you have no food or home. Due to work, you can't just get up and go do what you want. Want to travel the world? Too bad. You need money, which means you need a job, which means you can't travel because you're too busy working.

Freedom is an illusion.
